parameters.name: Definition
parameters.description:
The definition of the flow. The definition must follow the syntax of Flow Definition Language (FDL). For forward compatibility, the system supports two versions of the flow definition specification.

> In the preceding example, Name: my\_flow\_name indicates the flow name, which must be the same as the value of the Name request parameter.

parameters.name: Environment
parameters.description: The list of variables that can be accessed during the execution of the flow.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the flow that you created.

parameters.name: RoleArn
parameters.description: The resource descriptor of the role that the flow execution relies on. When a flow is executed, the execution engine assumes this role to call the related resource APIs.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of the flow. Set the value to **FDL**.
